products.summary: Medicines, batches and expiry, the counter and prescriptions, with Finance & Accounting when you want the books.
overview: Pharmacy ERP runs the whole pharmacy in one place: the medicines you stock, every batch with its expiry date and cost, the counter where you sell, the prescriptions you dispense and the cash in each till. It is made for retail pharmacies, medical stores and pharmaceutical wholesalers, from a single shop to many branches.

Stock is tracked by batch from the moment it arrives. Goods are received against purchase orders onto a shelf or into the fridge, each batch with its number, expiry date and cost. The counter always sells the batch that expires first and refuses anything expired. A batch can be put on hold in one step, recalled stock never sells, and near-expiry reports show what to move before it is lost.

At the counter, cashiers search or scan, apply approved discounts, take cash, mobile money or card, and print an 80 mm receipt. Prescriptions are recorded and verified by a pharmacist before they are dispensed, and can be dispensed in part when stock is short. Every movement of a controlled drug is written to a register that is ready for inspection.

Each cashier opens a till and counts it at closing, so any over or short is on record. The counter also runs on Windows PCs and on Android and iOS phones and tablets, and keeps selling when the internet drops: sales are sent once the connection is back. For a pharmacy with no internet at all, a standalone edition runs a single branch on one PC.
Pharmacy ERP works on its own. Add Finance & Accounting and every sale, purchase, return and write-off posts to your ledger automatically, so the books are up to date at the end of each day.

products.summary: Double-entry accounting with bank reconciliation, tax, budgets and fixed assets.
overview: Finance & Accounting keeps a business's books in one place: a double-entry ledger, sales and purchases, the bank, tax, budgets and fixed assets, and the financial statements that come from them. It is for businesses that want proper books, for the accountants who serve them, and for every business that runs one of our ERPs.

Everything is recorded in a chart of accounts and journals that always balance. Mistakes are corrected with reversals rather than edits, so the audit trail stays whole. Invoices and receipts, bills and supplier payments, credits and returns all post to the ledger as they happen.

Bank statements are imported as CSV and matched against the ledger: accept the suggested matches, save rules for the ones that repeat, and reconcile to the statement balance. Accounts, invoices and payments can be in foreign currencies, with daily rates and a revaluation at month-end.

At month-end, lock each month in order; at year-end, close the year into retained earnings. Set tax codes, run the tax return for any period, and filing it locks that period and prepares the settlement journal. Track budgets against actual figures, and keep an asset register that depreciates every month.

Run the trial balance, profit and loss, balance sheet, aged receivables and payables, and cash flow from the same ledger at any time. Finance & Accounting works on its own, and when you add an ERP its sales, purchases, stock and cash post to your books automatically. Opening balances let you carry on from where you are today.
products.headline: Accounting your accountant will trust.
products.subhead: A double-entry ledger with periods, bank reconciliation, tax, budgets and fixed assets, fed automatically by our ERPs or used on its own.
products.audience: Businesses that want proper books, the accountants who serve them, and every customer of our ERPs.
products.seoDescription: Accounting software with a double-entry ledger, bank reconciliation, tax returns, budgets, fixed assets and multi-currency.

features.title: The ledger
features.body: A chart of accounts you can shape to your business, and journals that must balance before they post. A posted entry is never edited or deleted: a mistake is corrected with a reversal, so every change stays visible. The general ledger shows each account's movements and running balance.

features.title: Sales and customers
features.body: Raise invoices with tax, record customer receipts against them, and void an invoice when it was raised in error. Money that comes in without an invoice is recorded too. Aged receivables show who owes what, and for how long.

features.title: Purchases and suppliers
features.body: Keep your suppliers, record their bills, and pay them when they are due. Recording a bill and paying it are separate steps, so different people can do each. Aged payables show what you owe, and to whom.

features.title: Bank reconciliation
features.body: Import a bank statement as a CSV file. Finance suggests matches with your ledger, you accept or change them, and anything missing can be entered straight from the statement line. Save rules for payments that repeat, then reconcile to the statement balance; a reconciliation can be undone if needed.

features.title: Journal approvals
features.body: Decide which manual journals need a second person. A journal that needs approval waits until someone else approves it; it can be rejected with a reason or withdrawn by whoever entered it. Nobody approves their own entry.

features.title: Payment requests
features.body: Money goes out through a request: prepared by one person, reviewed, approved and then disbursed, with each step done by someone with that role. You set when a review is needed, and a request can be rejected or withdrawn along the way.

features.title: Petty cash
features.body: Give each petty cash fund a custodian. They pay small expenses with a voucher and attach the receipt; vouchers are verified or rejected, the fund is counted, and it is topped back up when it runs low. Funds can be handed to another custodian or closed.

features.title: Recurring journals
features.body: Set up entries that repeat, such as rent, accruals or depreciation adjustments, once. They run on schedule, can be paused, and go through approval like any other journal.

features.title: Cost centres and projects
features.body: Tag income and costs to cost centres and projects as you record them. Profit and loss by cost centre or project shows where money is made and spent.

features.title: Month-end and year-end
features.body: Lock each month in order so nothing changes after it is closed, and unlock one when a correction is really needed. At year-end, close the year into retained earnings. Opening balances let you start from where your books are today.

features.title: Tax
features.body: Set up tax codes for sales and purchases. Run the tax return for any period from the ledger; filing it locks that period, and settling it records the payment or refund journal.

features.title: Multi-currency
features.body: Keep accounts, invoices, bills and payments in foreign currencies alongside your own. Enter daily exchange rates, and revalue foreign-currency balances at month-end so gains and losses are recorded.

features.title: Budgets
features.body: Set a budget for each account for the year, then compare it with the actual figures as the months go by. Budget against actuals can be exported to Excel.

features.title: Fixed assets
features.body: Register equipment, vehicles and buildings by category, and run depreciation every month to post it to the ledger. When an asset is sold or written off, dispose of it and the gain or loss is recorded.

features.title: Reports
features.body: Trial balance, profit and loss, balance sheet, cash flow, general ledger, aged receivables and payables, and financial ratios, for any dates and compared with another period. The main statements export to Excel.

features.title: Roles and audit trail
features.body: Give each person a ready-made role, from Cashier and Accountant to Finance Manager and a read-only Auditor, so they see and do only their part. The audit trail records who approved, paid, reversed, locked or changed what, and when.

workflow.title: Record
workflow.body: Sales and purchases arrive from your ERP, or are entered in Finance & Accounting directly.

workflow.title: Reconcile
workflow.body: Match the bank statement and lock the month.

workflow.title: Report
workflow.body: Run the statements and file the tax return from the same ledger.

features.title: Into the books
features.body: Add Finance & Accounting and each approved payroll posts one journal of totals, then the payment when it goes out.

workflow.title: Prepare
workflow.body: Choose the month and the pay date. Every payslip is worked out.

workflow.title: Approve
workflow.body: A second person checks and approves. The payroll and its payslips are locked.

workflow.title: Pay
workflow.body: Pay by bank, cash or mobile money and record it as paid.

faqs.question: Do I need Miles HR?
faqs.answer: No. Add people in Payroll yourself. With HR, they arrive from HR and only their pay is entered in Payroll.

faqs.question: Can I add it to my restaurant, pharmacy or shop?
faqs.answer: Yes. Payroll works next to any Miles ERP, or on its own.

faqs.question: Are tax rates set for my country?
faqs.answer: You enter your tax bands and social security rates, or start from a South Sudan preset and check it against the current law before your first payroll.

faqs.question: Is accounting included?
faqs.answer: Finance & Accounting is a separate application. Add it and each payroll posts to your books, without anyone's individual pay.

products.name: Procurement
products.summary: From purchase request to delivery. All connected.
products.headline: Buy right, with approvals.
products.subhead: Miles Procurement is being built for organizations that need plans, requests, approvals and supplier quotes before they buy, and proof of what arrived after.
products.audience: Organizations with purchasing approvals: NGOs, schools, companies with several departments.
products.seoDescription: Procurement software on the way: purchase requests with approvals, RFQs and tenders, purchase orders, receiving and supplier invoices that can flow into Finance.

features.title: Purchase requests
features.body: Departments ask for what they need.

features.title: Approvals
features.body: The right people approve before anything is ordered.

features.title: Quotes and orders
features.body: Compare supplier quotes, in any currency, and raise the purchase order.

features.title: Receiving and invoices
features.body: Record what arrived and match the supplier's invoice against it.

workflow.title: Request
workflow.body: A department raises a purchase request.

workflow.title: Approve
workflow.body: Approvers sign off, in order.

workflow.title: Order
workflow.body: The order goes out; receipts and the supplier's invoice are matched against it.

faqs.question: When will Procurement be available?
faqs.answer: It is being built. Join the waitlist and we will tell you first.

faqs.question: Do I need Finance & Accounting?
faqs.answer: No. Procurement works on its own. With Finance & Accounting, matched supplier invoices can be sent there as bills.

products.name: Logbook
products.summary: Structured operational records, reviewed and traceable.
products.headline: Every shift, on the record.
products.subhead: Miles Logbook replaces paper log books: daily activity, generator, vehicle and maintenance logs built from your own forms, numbered, reviewed by a supervisor and kept with a permanent history.
products.audience: Organizations that keep operational logs: facilities, IT, fleet, security and field offices.
products.seoDescription: Digital logbook software: build your own log sheets, record numbered entries with attachments, have supervisors review them, and export reports to CSV and PDF.

features.title: Your own log sheets
features.body: Build the form once from twelve field types, or start from a ready-made generator, vehicle, activity or IT log.

features.title: Supervisor review
features.body: Entries are checked by someone else, returned for correction when needed, and marked reviewed.

features.title: Reports and exports
features.body: Filter by date, person or status, see totals such as fuel used or kilometres driven, and export to CSV or PDF.

features.title: A history nobody edits
features.body: Every entry gets its own number, every change is kept, and the audit trail cannot be altered.

workflow.title: Record
workflow.body: Staff fill in the log sheet and attach photos or documents.

workflow.title: Review
workflow.body: A supervisor marks the entry reviewed, or returns it with a comment.

workflow.title: Report
workflow.body: Managers see totals and export the records they need.

faqs.question: Can we change a log sheet after people use it?
faqs.answer: Yes. Each change is published as a new version; entries already written keep the version they were written on.

faqs.question: Does Logbook work offline or on phones?
faqs.answer: Yes. Logbook works in the browser on phones as well as computers, and the Miles Logbook Android app, coming soon to Google Play, lets staff write entries with no signal. Entries wait safely on the phone and are sent, once only, when the connection is back. Supervisors can review entries in the app too.

features.title: Transfers

features.title: Counts and reorders
features.body: Stock counts and reorder alerts.

workflow.title: Receive
workflow.body: Stock arrives into a location.

workflow.title: Move

workflow.title: Count
workflow.body: Count and correct, with every change on record.

faqs.question: Is stock control available today?
faqs.answer: Yes, inside Pharmacy ERP and Retail ERP. A standalone Inventory application is planned.

features.title: Asset register

features.title: Assignments
features.body: Who has which asset.

features.title: Maintenance
features.body: Service schedules and history.

workflow.title: Register

workflow.title: Assign

workflow.title: Maintain

faqs.question: Can I depreciate assets today?
faqs.answer: Yes. Finance & Accounting has an asset register with monthly depreciation and disposals. Asset Management will add day-to-day tracking.
